policy: Preserve every existing public URL indefinitely. Original content pages must remain direct content with their original canonical URL. New company/product URLs are additive.

verification_scope.adjacent_repositories: public docs, README and store/marketing metadata only
verification_scope.caveat: Absence from repository docs does not prove a URL is unregistered in App Store Connect. Current external registration values require authenticated live verification.
verification_scope.status_note: Existing /404.html files are explicit static URLs and should return HTTP 200; a nonexistent request path should return HTTP 404 with the custom 404 page.
